SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT HD.COMPANY_CODE, HD.DIVISION_CODE, HD.IF_HEADER_ID, DT.IF_DETAIL_ID FROM STX_MRO_RFQ_HEADER@STXMFG HD, STX_MRO_RFQ_LINE@STXMFG DT WHERE 1 = 1 AND DT.COMPANY_CODE = HD.COMPANY_CODE AND DT.DIVISION_CODE = HD.DIVISION_CODE AND DT.IF_HEADER_ID = HD.IF_HEADER_ID AND DT.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY HD.COMPANY_CODE, HD.DIVISION_CODE, HD.IF_HEADER_ID, DT.IF_DETAIL_ID
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'STX1' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(DT.DIVISION_CODE,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(DT.RFQ_NO,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(DT.RFQ_SEQ,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, '01' AS REVISION, NVL(DT.IF_STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, NVL(TO_CHAR(HD.RFQ_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(TO_CHAR(DT.RFQ_DELIVERY_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(DT.ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(DT.DESCRIPTION_LOC,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(DT.UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(DT.RFQ_PRICE, 0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, NVL(TO_CHAR(HD.RFQ_CLOSE_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, NVL(TO_CHAR(HD.RFQ_CLOSE_DATE,'HH24MISS'),'000000') AS CLOSE_TIME, NVL(DT.RFQ_QTY, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(DT.BUYER_REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, DT.PROJECT_NO || '^' || DT.PROJECT_NAME AS ETC_REMARK, DT.COMPANY_CODE || '^' || DT.DIVISION_CODE || '^' || DT.IF_HEADER_ID || '^' || DT.IF_DETAIL_ID AS REF_IF_NO FROM STX_MRO_RFQ_HEADER@STXMFG HD, STX_MRO_RFQ_LINE@STXMFG DT WHERE 1 = 1 AND DT.COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND DT.DIVISION_CODE = '$G_RS.DIVISION_CODE$' AND DT.IF_HEADER_ID = '$G_RS.IF_HEADER_ID$' AND DT.IF_DETAIL_ID = '$G_RS.IF_DETAIL_ID$' AND DT.COMPANY_CODE = HD.COMPANY_CODE AND DT.DIVISION_CODE = HD.DIVISION_CODE AND DT.IF_HEADER_ID = HD.IF_HEADER_ID ORDER BY DT.COMPANY_CODE,DT.DIVISION_CODE,DT.IF_HEADER_ID,DT.IF_DETAIL_ID
UPDATE STX_MRO_RFQ_LINE@STXMFG DT SET DT.IF_FLAG = 'Y', DT.IF_RECV_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND DT.COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND DT.DIVISION_CODE = '$G_RS.DIVISION_CODE$' AND DT.IF_HEADER_ID = $G_RS.IF_HEADER_ID$ AND DT.IF_DETAIL_ID = $G_RS.IF_DETAIL_ID$
